rows.llm_rationale: Crowd price of 3.8% appears underweighting tail risks. With ~5.5 months remaining, base rates for major military invasions, recent cross-strait tensions, and asymmetric incentive structures (PRC benefits from ambiguity; markets underprice rare high-impact events) suggest true probability is modestly higher. However, no imminent invasion indicators support crowd skepticism. 6% reflects elevated but still low probability.
rows.question: Will China invade Taiwan by end of 2026?
